title: GST reforms from Nov 1: Faster refunds, easier registration for sellers
description:
Simplified GST registration for small sellers on  e-commerce platforms, unified documentation for GST registration, faster refunds, and a Rs 10,000 threshold for issuing GST notices are some of the Goods and Services Tax process reforms that are likely to be rolled out from November 1, an official said on Thursday.
The 57th GST Council meeting on October 8 approved a host of reforms in GST processes, primarily covering registration, returns, refund and adjudication.
Officials said some of the changes approved by the Council that can be implemented through administrative processes will be brought into effect in phases from November 1, 2026. The changes which require an amendment to the GST law would be implemented from April 1, 2027.
The notifications and circulars on the relevant process reforms have already been approved by the legal department and are likely to be issued on Friday, an official said.
